tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Explore Results
tool.description: reopen one complete RADAR-PD result as an integrated scientific dashboard
tool.command: #import re touch '$session_log' && chmod a+r '$session_log' && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p site/{plots,tables,phases,gpx,diagnostics} && #if str($result_source.source_kind) == 'archive' mkdir -p bundle && unzip -q '$result_source.results_archive' -d bundle && test -f bundle/ndip/report.html && test -f bundle/ndip/summary.json && cp bundle/ndip/report.html site/index.html && cp bundle/ndip/summary.json site/summary.json && for collection in plots tables phases gpx diagnostics; do if [ -d "bundle/ndip/\${collection}" ]; then cp -R "bundle/ndip/\${collection}/." "site/\${collection}/" fi done && #else cp '$result_source.report' site/index.html && cp '$result_source.summary' site/summary.json && #if str($result_source.plots) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $result_source.plots #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/plots/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($result_source.tables) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $result_source.tables #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/tables/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($result_source.phases) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $result_source.phases #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/phases/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($result_source.gpx_projects) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $result_source.gpx_projects #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/gpx/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($result_source.diagnostics) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $result_source.diagnostics #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/diagnostics/$name' && #end for #end if #end if printf '%s\n' 'RADAR-PD interactive result explorer started on port 8080.' > '$session_log' && python -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory site

param.name: source_kind
param.label: Result source
param.help: For current runs, select the one Complete Results Archive. Individual outputs remain available only for older runs.
param.option: Individual outputs from an older run

param.name: results_archive
param.label: RADAR-PD Complete Results Archive
param.help: Select the numbered Complete Results Archive produced by RADAR-PD Analyze. It contains the dashboard and every linked scientific output.

tool.help: Open this after a RADAR-PD analysis and select its single **Complete Results Archive**. The explorer restores the integrated dashboard, fit plots, result tables, CIF files, diagnostics, and curated GSAS-II checkpoints without reconnecting each History dataset. Galaxy remains the system of record. To continue a refinement, send a selected GPX checkpoint through **RADAR-PD Utility: GSAS-II Project Handoff** and open it in the hosted GSAS-II tool.
